For Q=2r sqrt(c) H Y+2rTY+aY^2+2bYW+dW^2 in the exact-null rank-three normal form, c>63/64 and sigma_min(M)>=1 imply ||p_Q||_p <= p (sqrt(128/63))^(1-1/p) for every finite p>1.
With A=K_H K_Y/(|r|sqrt(c)), intervals of length epsilon with A epsilon<=e^-2 satisfy P(Q in I)<=e A epsilon log(1/(A epsilon)).
